purpose: Teach: ありふれ/眠ら/怯え/おろそか/膨れ/太り/はいり/たたい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ありふれた毎日がお父さんと一緒で幸せね
lines.en: Sho, it's wonderful that you get to spend ordinary days with Dad.
lines.style: Warm, almost to herself. Gentle observation about his happiness. Soft landing on the final word. The quiet contentment of a mother noticing something true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが眠らずに看病して下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad stayed up all night to take care of me.
lines.style: Quiet pride mixed with dawning understanding. Small voice, but steady. He's offering this fact like a precious thing he just learned about Dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、雷で怯えちゃダメよ、お父さんが守って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, don't let the thunder frighten you. Dad will keep you safe.
lines.style: Reassuring and certain. Not coddling — this is a simple fact. Warm tone, steady rhythm. The voice of someone who knows he's protected.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宿題をおろそかにしないって誓うよ
lines.en: Mom, I promise I won't neglect my homework.
lines.style: Serious, almost formal in his small voice. He's making a vow he takes seriously. Slight emphasis on the promise itself. Earnest without being strained.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お餅がお腹で膨れて苦しそうね
lines.en: Sho, looks like that mochi is making your stomach ache.
lines.style: Observant, gently amused. She notices his discomfort without fuss. Practical tone — she's already thinking about what to do next.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがちょっと太り始めたって心配してたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was worried Dad was starting to get a little heavier.
lines.style: Quiet, understated dry wit from a six-year-old. He's noticed something grown-ups pretend not to see. Small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋にはいりたい時はノックしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, remember to knock before you come into a room.
lines.style: Gentle guidance, the voice of everyday teaching. Not stern — just matter-of-fact kindness. The tone of someone establishing a simple boundary with care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに優しく頭をたたいてもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad patted my head so gently.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. He's replaying a small kindness. Voice full of simple happiness. The kind of memory a child holds like something precious.
